note: Vocabulary of the design-around assistant (web/engine/x-designaround.js, LnpDesign). The engine code is general; every class of linker, head group and every step size lives here. Linker SMILES are written left to right with unnumbered '*' for the two ends, exactly like Markush linker alternatives (docs/MARKUSH.md); head groups have one '*' for the attachment. The engine tries each listed linker in both directions. A class that the claim lists for the variable is never proposed for that variable. Edit this file to change the idea space; no code change is needed.

chain.note: Carbon counts and repeat counts are moved just outside each claimed range: max + 1 ... max + aboveMax and min - 1 ... min - belowMin (never below minCarbons for a group, never below 0 for a repeat).

unsaturation.note: C=C count moved outside a dbl range by one step: a C=C is put near the middle of the longest carbon path of the group (cis/trans not set), or one C=C is reduced to a single bond.

branching.note: When a rule fixes branched true/false: a linear group gets a methyl branch on the carbon next to the attachment and loses one terminal carbon (same carbon count); a branched plain hydrocarbon group is rebuilt as the linear chain with the same carbon count.

linkerSwaps.note: Which present linkers are offered for a swap (ids of linkers above); the replacement can be any other linker class. maxPerSite caps the replacements per linker occurrence.

headSwaps.note: A present head group is replaced by the other members of its family (and by the families listed in 'cross'). maxPerSite caps the replacements per occurrence.

combinations.note: Pairs of two single moves on different atoms. Share of the variant cap that combinations may take, and the most promising single moves (lowest structural change first) used to build them.

formulation.note: Values of a product profile moved just outside a claimed range: lo - step (lower side) or hi + step (upper side), rounded to 'digits'. min / max keep the value physically possible. A mol % change of one lipid is compensated on the lipid named in 'compensate' (role order), so the mol % still add up to 100.

risk.note: Inputs of the remaining-risk score (0-4) of x-designaround.js; the formula itself is documented in the file header. simHigh / simLow: count-fingerprint similarity thresholds for claim compounds; crowd: number of distinct live publications with a contribution of 2 or more that adds one step.
